title: 第21章 你很好第22章
slug: 无敌的女厉鬼有点恋爱脑
lines: 这毫无征兆，凭空出现的鬼新娘，说实话差点儿给陆远吓得蹦到桌子上。
一股寒意从尾椎骨直冲天灵盖。
上次两人虽然也见过，并且距离也挺近。
但那时的陆远被两脚羊整的早已经是意识快要消散，整个人都是迷迷糊糊的。
根本都来不及多寻思，便是两眼一黑直接晕了过去。
而现在，在陆远意识清楚的情况下，这鬼新娘出现在陆远身后。
并且，这一次，两人的距离可比上次近多了，这鬼新娘几乎就贴在陆远身后飘着。
一时间，陆远完全傻掉了。
完全不知道该怎么办。
但有一说一，虽然陆远回头的那一刹那大骇，但回过神来后，那种恐惧感却竟是慢慢消失。
陆远刚才被吓的头皮发麻，那是因为身后突然出现了个东西。
换句话来说，就算身后飘着的不是这鬼新娘，换做是其他什么东西，陆远也会被吓一跳。
但回过神来后，心中大骇在消退，非常莫名其妙的感觉没那么怕了。
一来，这鬼新娘在帮陆远。
伸手帮陆远扶正三灯，这明显是善意之举，并没有加害之意，自然没有那么怕。
另外便就是……
如果有邪祟不怀好意，亦或是想要加害于你，亦或是什么其他的鬼心眼子，注意到你时。
人的三魂六魄是会有所感应的。
那种感觉有点儿难以形容。
非要举例的话，就好比一个人走夜路，突然莫名感觉身后阴恻恻的，有人在盯着你。
也可能是明明在一个非常熟悉的地方，比如家中，宿舍，厕所，某个瞬间莫名感觉不舒服，阴森森的。
这就是有脏东西在窥视你。
而现在，陆远跟这鬼新娘贴的这么近，却是没有任何那种不适感。
这也代表，这鬼新娘对陆远没有什么恶意。
甚至来说，这鬼新娘在刻意压制体内邪气，不让陆远有所不适。
这般下来，即使身后是一只二十星的超级大凶，陆远也不至于吓到六神无主。
也就在此时，法坛之上，三灯汇聚而成的那股乳白色烟柱，香气已浓郁到了极点。
供桌中央，那具被铁锨拍得有些扁平的黄皮子尸身，忽然微微起伏。
像是漏气的皮球被重新吹满了气，尸身迅速变得饱满、充盈。
最终，这黄焖鸡的尸身猛地一哆嗦，下一秒，便是直直站了起来。
要说这黄焖鸡真是精得要死。
起来的一瞬间，陆远还没弄明白怎么回事呢。
这家伙就猛地跳下法坛，落地的瞬间，便“噗通”一声，学着人样五体投地跪伏下去。
尖锐的嗓音带着十二分的谄媚与恐惧。
“小的参见大仙！！”
你妈！
抢自己活计！
回过神来的陆远，也是赶紧转头，躬身拱手低头，朝着面前这片血红色身影立即道：
content_en:
This ghost bride appeared out of thin air without warning. To be honest, Lu Yuan almost jumped on the table in fright.
A chill shot from the tailbone to the sky.
Although the two of them met last time, they were quite close to each other.
But at that time, Lu Yuan was so beaten by the two-legged sheep that his consciousness was about to disappear, and he was in a daze.
He didn't even have time to think about it, his eyes went dark and he fainted.
But now, with Lu Yuan's consciousness clear, the ghost bride appeared behind Lu Yuan.
Moreover, this time, the distance between the two was much closer than last time, and the ghost bride was almost floating behind Lu Yuan.
For a moment, Lu Yuan was completely stunned.
Totally don't know what to do.
But one thing is that although Lu Yuan was horrified when he turned around, that feeling of fear slowly disappeared after he came back to his senses.
Lu Yuan was so frightened that his scalp was numb just now. That was because something suddenly appeared behind him.
In other words, even if what was floating behind him was not the ghost bride, but something else, Lu Yuan would still be shocked.
But after I came back to my senses, the fear in my heart was fading away, and I felt that I was not so scared anymore.
First, this ghost bride is helping Lu Yuan.
He stretched out his hand to help Lu Yuan straighten the three lights. This was obviously a kind gesture and did not mean any harm, so naturally he was not that afraid.
The other thing is...
If there are evil spirits with bad intentions, or they want to harm you, or there are other evil intentions, when they notice you.
People's three souls and six souls will be sensitive to it.
The feeling is a bit indescribable.
If you have to give an example, it's like walking alone at night, and suddenly you feel a gloomy feeling behind you, and someone is staring at you.
It may also be that you are in a very familiar place, such as home, dormitory, toilet, and feel uncomfortable and eerie for no reason at a certain moment.
There's something dirty watching you.
But now, Lu Yuan is so close to this ghost bride, but he doesn't feel any discomfort.
This also means that this ghost bride has no ill intentions towards Lu Yuan.
It can even be said that this ghost bride is deliberately suppressing the evil energy in her body to prevent Lu Yuan from feeling uncomfortable.
In this way, even if there is a twenty-star super evil behind him, Lu Yuan will not scare Liu Shen Wu Zhu.
At this moment, above the altar, the milky white smoke column formed by the three lights gathered, and the aroma was extremely rich.
In the center of the altar table, the yellow-leather corpse that had been flattened by the shovel suddenly rose and fell slightly.
Like a deflated rubber ball being inflated again, the corpse quickly became plump and full.
Finally, the body of the braised chicken trembled violently, and the next second, it stood up straight.
I have to say that this braised chicken is really delicious.
The moment he got up, Lu Yuan still didn't understand what was going on.
This guy suddenly jumped off the altar. The moment he landed, he made a "pop" sound and knelt down on the ground like a human being.
The sharp voice was full of flattery and fear.
"Young little see the Great Immortal!!"
Lu Yuan: "..."
Your mother!
Steal your own job!
Lu Yuan, who came back to his senses, quickly turned his head, bowed his head, and said immediately to the blood-red figure in front of him:
